findings.issue_category: public bucket access with no encryption
findings.description: This bucket is explicitly noted as public and lacks an ACL restricting access, has no server_side_encryption_configuration, no versioning, and no access logging, making sensitive data (customer-master.xlsx) potentially exposed to anyone and unprotected at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data stored in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded into the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving it unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored operations data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored data science data unencrypted at rest.
